mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated interest rates reduce corporate borrowing and equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of observations when FEDFUNDS is above its 5-year median, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5%, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market reaction to restrictive monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 3.5), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) signals a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as investors price in higher discount rates and recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 3.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 200), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL > 200), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 days due to reduced liquidity and heightened recession expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.5 and CPIAUCSL > 200, or the Rank IC for the regime-conditional signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as robust economic activity supports corporate earnings and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of observations when GDPC1 is above its 5-year median, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to a tight labor market boosting consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.5), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 120 and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2000 thousand units, the economy is in a strong expansion phase, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as supply chain bottlenecks ease and manufacturing activity accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (INDPRO > 120 AND HOUST > 2000), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market (characterized by unemployment below 4.0% and strong job growth above 130,000 jobs), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 20 days due to sustained corporate earnings momentum before potential policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 130000, or the Rank IC for the regime-conditional signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
